# lucidity_roles (Data Source)

Lists the roles users can be granted on the caller's Lucidity account. Account admin is not a role: it bypasses role checks entirely.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lucidity_roles" "all" {}

output "role_names" {
  value = [for r in data.lucidity_roles.all.roles : r.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Lucidity tenant ID (e.g. lucidity_tenant.<name>.tenant_id) to act on, sent as the X-tenant header. Overrides the provider's tenant_id; leave unset to use it. Needed when authenticating as a service account with roles on several tenants.

### Read-Only

- `roles` (Attributes List) Every role on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Role name; identifies the role (there is no role ID).
- `new_user_default` (Boolean) Whether new users get this role by default.
- `permissions` (Attributes List) What the role allows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--roles--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles.permissions`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) Action, e.g. `READ` or `WRITE`.
- `resource` (String) Resource type, e.g. `volume`.
